<thought>Based on the protection reaction, the precursors are the free alcohol (obtained by removing the silyl group) and the silylating reagent trimethylsilyl triflate (TMSOTf). The free alcohol SMILES is inferred as O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O and the TMSOTf SMILES is C[Si](C)(C)OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F.</thought>
<final_answer>[["O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O","C[Si](C)(C)OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F"]]</final_answer>
